text.card: A red giant 4,246 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.82 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,716 K at its surface.
